pb-app-testing.title: App tests and demos
pb-app-testing.intro: Review client builds on a clean emulator, or prepare a video in a separate desktop. Approve every step.
pb-app-testing.legal: Live client testing, recording and delivery wait for a lawyer to confirm the permission rule. Prepare the plan meanwhile.
pb-app-testing.readFailed: Could not read the current work. Try again.
pb-app-testing.error: This step stopped ({code}). Review the current work and its permission.
pb-app-testing.testAccount: The client supplied a test account with fictional data
pb-app-testing.disclosureHelp: Put this sentence on its own line in the description: This video uses an AI voice.
pb-app-testing.approveScript: Approve this exact script and shot list
pb-app-testing.dirty: Save your changes before approving or running another step.
pb-app-testing.dockerHelp: Install Docker and prepare the Chausar image yourself. The browser rehearsal cannot record a desktop.
pb-app-testing.exactStep: This exact operation will run once after approval.
pb-app-testing.androidHelp: Use the desktop app with Android SDK tools and a clean emulator. No real phone or personal account is allowed.
pb-app-testing.fromClient: This APK came from this client
pb-app-testing.lease: This private desktop ends after one hour. Its container is removed on exit or expiry.
pb-app-testing.accountHelp: Open the separate viewer and sign in to the client test account yourself. Never enter secrets in these controls.
pb-app-testing.screenAlt: Current isolated desktop with the Chausar agent marker
pb-app-testing.phase.not-run: Did not run; prepare a new approval
pb-app-testing.phase.unknown: May have run; inspect it yourself, do not retry
pb-app-testing.captionHelp: Use the approved script exactly. Split it into short captions and set their times after listening. No word timing is invented.
pb-app-testing.timingNotRun: Caption pause checks have no measured word times. Check timing by watching and listening yourself.
pb-app-testing.watched: I watched the whole rendered video
pb-app-testing.audioChecked: I checked the audio and caption timing
pb-app-testing.downloadHelp: Download these reviewed files, then deliver them yourself. No client was contacted.
pb-app-testing.aiPlan: Ask AI for a draft plan
pb-app-testing.aiHelp: Your configured AI can draft a plan from the current source. Review the exact request and maximum cost first. Private sources need a qualified local model.
pb-app-testing.speechHelp: Use a licensed stock voice with current narration rights. Each paid segment needs a separate exact approval. Private scripts stay local until a suitable voice route is qualified.
pb-app-testing.voiceFormula: Code counts source characters and applies the dated provider rate or your saved rate. The reservation shown is the spend limit for this exact call.
pb-app-testing.voiceMade: Audio received. Listen to it in the final video review.
pb-app-testing.voiceUnknown: This voice request may be charged. Check provider usage yourself; it will not retry automatically.
pb-app-testing.coverage: Coverage is limited to the executed steps and captured log. It is not a full quality or security assessment.
pb-app-testing.noFindings: No matching findings in this log. This does not prove the app is correct.
pb-app-testing.observed: What you saw when repeating it
pb-app-testing.emulatorHelp: Keep the clean emulator visible. Each action reads its current screen, then waits for your exact approval. Enter no personal accounts.
pb-app-testing.changedSource: The saved source changed. Your unsaved words are kept, but cannot replace a version you have not reviewed.
pb-app-testing.reloadSource: Discard edits and load current source
